title_en: The Winter Melon That Couldn't Get Out the Gate
note_en: Verb + 不 + result/direction says an action can't be carried through: 冬瓜搬不出去 "the melon couldn't be moved out" (they tried, it wouldn't go). The positive form is 搬得出去 "can be moved out." Likewise 装不下 "won't fit," 插不进去 "can't get it in." The video title uses the close variant with 了: 出不了门 "can't get out the gate."
